items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: I'll tell you all, just when, when I always start trying to sing is when Lurie Stahl's strong and coming out with the Heavey Jeeves.

ctx.x: Did his brother Joe Rene ever play with you too?

No I didn't want to think I would play with you. I was trying to think about. Did you ever do any singing in those bands? Oh no not at that time. This year lately I started. When did you start to sing about? Oh I started around about, singing around about 30, 30 now. Long and right before the war. I'll tell you all, just when I always start trying to sing is when Lurie Stahl's
strong and coming out and coming out and coming out and coming out and coming out and coming out.
